columns_comment.comment: Canonical optional meeting description added during legacy-schema reconciliation.
Canonical end timestamp. Backfilled from legacy ended_at where ends_at is null.
Canonical public-visibility flag. Default false. No RLS policy changes are made by this reconciliation.
Canonical meeting slug. Incident reconciliation preserves legacy room_code and backfills slug from trimmed room_code when safe, otherwise room-<uuid-without-hyphens>.
Canonical start timestamp. Backfilled from legacy started_at where starts_at is null.
Canonical update timestamp. Initialized from created_at or now(); no maintenance trigger is introduced in this incident repair.
